Browse, organize, and edit files on your iPhone or iPad, with root access on supported roothide and rootless bootstraps.

## Features

- **Organize files:** Copy, move, rename, and search by name. Keep folders open in tabs and restore deleted items from Trash.
- **View and edit:** Edit text and property lists, preview images and PDFs, play media, and inspect files in hex.
- **Manage archives:** Create ZIP and TAR archives, and browse or extract formats including ZIP, TAR, 7z, and RAR.
- **Connect and share:** Browse SMB shares, download files, and share folders through a browser or WebDAV client.
- **Work with apps:** Browse app folders and install packages when your installation allows it.
- **Use a terminal:** Open a shell in the current folder with the Debian package. Root sessions require Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode.

## Compatibility

Requires iOS 15 or later. The Debian packages support roothide and rootless bootstraps and include root access. TrollStore and sideloaded versions are also available on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/Fila/releases), with different file access and no terminal.

Available in 13 languages. [Read the guide](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/Fila#using-fila) or [join the community](https://discord.gg/vqhDEep2mN).

- Fila stays in portrait on iPhone. iPad still rotates freely.
- The Cancel button on a progress card is now a filled button, like the single button on other alerts, and dims when the work cannot be stopped part-way.
- On a jailbreak whose bootstrap has its own `mobile` folder, the sidebar lists both: Mobile (System) and Mobile (Bootstrap).

Includes RootHide and rootless Debian packages, TrollStore TIPA, standard IPA, and SHA-256 checksums.

- `fila://` by itself now opens Fila without changing the current screen.
- `fila://view/path` matches Filza: a folder opens; a file is selected in its parent without preview. `fila://view?path=` still opens the viewer.

- Remove speculative directory prefetching and its shared cache after reports of navigation and tab-switching stutter in 0.4.2.
- Remove eager browser loading before navigation. Load the visible directory and retain an existing tab's contents during refresh.
- Cancel directory reads when leaving a page, discard late results, and release abandoned paginated listing handles.
- Prevent hidden browser tabs from starting refreshes in response to file-operation notifications.

Includes RootHide and rootless Debian packages, TrollStore TIPA, standard IPA, and SHA-256 checksums.

- Add album artwork, clearer song rows, and a large artwork preview in song details.
- Add song export through Save To, with an editable filename based on the song title, plus deletion in the details menu.
- Refresh populated music lists in the background and keep mutation progress visible through the confirmed list update.
- Use the native single-entity deletion API instead of a batch import session.
- Hide settings and bookmarks in the tab overview when the sidebar is visible. Close All opens a new tab at the configured launch location, which now defaults to the last visited folder.
- Include directory prefetching and automatic keyboard focus when search opens.

Validation: host tests and project/localization checks passed; the combined iOS build passed before the version update. The revised music deletion path still needs iPad runtime regression testing. An iOS 18.5 MusicLibrary I/O failure was investigated and its database was backed up; system recovery rebuilt that test library empty, which the owner chose to retain. This release does not claim that incident's underlying cause is fully resolved.

## 更新内容

- 修复 iOS 18 下从收藏、书签跳转目录时闪退的问题。
- 支持双指滑动进入文件多选。
- 为错误弹窗补齐关闭按钮；批量移入废纸篓失败时可关闭或永久删除原路径上剩余的项目。
- 永久删除确认统一使用红色按钮，删除图标统一使用标准垃圾桶图标。
- 成功提示简化为单行勾选样式，保留撤销；错误改用可关闭的弹窗。
- 侧边栏新增可折叠的“挂载点”分区，由后端提供挂载路径和只读状态。

## 安装包

- `iphoneos-arm64e.deb`：RootHide
- `iphoneos-arm64.deb`：rootless
- `.tipa`：TrollStore
- `.ipa`：常规重签名安装，包含标准 App Group entitlement
